title: Stack text formatting decorators
description: Text is an interface with a single render() method. PlainText is the base implementation. BoldDecorator, ItalicDecorator, and UpperCaseDecorator each wrap any Text and transform its output. Implement the three decorators so they can be stacked in any order.
hints: Each decorator stores a reference to the inner Text and calls its render() first
BoldDecorator wraps the result in ** ... **, ItalicDecorator in _ ... _
UpperCaseDecorator calls toUpperCase() on the inner render() result
issues: Adding formatting combinations through subclassing causes a class explosion (BoldItalic, BoldUpperCase, BoldItalicUpperCase, …)
Formatting cannot be added or removed at runtime with inheritance
overallGoal: Use the Decorator pattern to compose text formatting dynamically, so any combination of bold, italic, and uppercase can be achieved by stacking decorators without extra subclasses.
goals: Create a Text interface (or abstract class) with a getContent() method
Implement each decorator (e.g. BoldDecorator, ItalicDecorator) wrapping an inner Text and transforming its output
Ensure decorators can be stacked in any order by always delegating to the inner Text
